name: Aditya Dashboard Design Language
source: Distilled from sales-automation Appearance ratings (35 rated combos) + 5 review rounds

light.chipHover: solid accent fill + contrast text + scale(1.05)
light.pressed: color-mix 92% base + scale(0.97), no shadow gain
light.selected: accent-soft fill + accent-ink text + 3px accent inset
light.rule: flat stays flat - states move color, never elevation

dark.primaryHover: brightness(1.12-1.15) + 4px accent halo (~35%) + shadow grows one step
dark.chipHover: solid accent fill + contrast text + scale(1.05)
dark.pressed: scale(0.97) + shadow collapses to none (the sink)
dark.selected: accent-soft + accent inset + brighter top hairline
dark.rule: depth speaks in dark - states move light and elevation together

states.tempo: all state transitions run at the theme's motion binding; press = hover/2

laws: Undertoned planes: the page itself is tinted (vivid), never paper-default
Two voices: chrome speaks quietly (desaturated accent), data speaks sharply (saturated bar channel)
Bold accent-ink readability: lighten + desaturate aInk before bolding
Chart wells must demarcate: dark themes → darker desaturated well; light themes → surface-white lift (or deeper well when the plane is too pale: emerald, mono)
Status chips (light): plane bg + accent dot + 50%-aInk hairline; (dark): accent-soft fill
Brightness ceiling: dim before glare; saturated yellow never a plane in light mode
Temperature decides mode: cool/deep packs live dark, warm/earthy packs live light
Atmosphere is whisper-quiet: washes 10-22% alpha, motifs 11-16% stroke, photos are per-project ingredients layered under the same wash recipe
Attention pops: page titles may take accent tone (solid, never gradient-clipped); gradients live only on special buttons with dark ink
Completed = neutral grey, never green beside red; amber never carries meaning alone

binding.rule: values are [hover, press, pane, ease]; press = hover/2, pane = hover*1.4, one tempo per theme

density.rule: compact steps every space token down one, body -1px, KPI -20%; radii, inks, accents never change. Tables may default compact while the shell stays comfortable.

global.barHeights: chart bars 6px 6px 2px 2px, side-only black shadow on dark themes

themes.name: Steel Night
grammar: night-sky or black planes
cards lift with black shadows
chart = flat desaturated well, never tinted
bar channel brighter than chrome (cobalt lesson)
bar shadow side-only: 3px 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.95), 6px 0 16px .6 + inset top hairline rgba(255,255,255,.18)
reserve: Cobalt (accent #5387ee — too loud as chrome, reborn as carbon's bars)

themes.name: Hearth Light
grammar: warm tinted planes; surfaces may DEEPEN (honey, tangerine)
paper-flat: no shadows on cards or bars
status chips: plane bg + accent dot + hairline
sunken-tile secondary ink deepened
sea-teal voice family (clay's slate the one exception)

colorways.name: Tangerine Vivid
colorways.note: rust data bars against teal chrome

themes.name: Jewel Night
grammar: tonal double-radial wash planes: accent glow top-right + deeper counterglow bottom-left on near-black
photos = per-project ingredients under the same wash
Steel's depth grammar (lift shadows, desat wells, side bar shadows)
special buttons: colorway gradient + dark ink
page titles: SOLID accent tone (gradient titles rejected)
wash hue must differ from tile cast (fuchsia lesson)
reserve: Orchid Vivid dark (discarded: redundant with fuchsia)

themes.name: Botanical Day
grammar: dense outline botanical motif layer in accent family: wallpaper density, whisper opacity (11-16% stroke)
one realistic multi-tonal mural allowed per theme (Garden Dawn)
flat light grammar + dot-chips
chart wells surface-white (emerald exception: deeper well on pale plane)
sunken wells deepened for demarcation against patterns

colorways.name: Garden Dawn
colorways.motif: realistic sketch garden: sage stems 20%, tan umbels + 5-petal blooms w/ 10% fills, teal leaf sprigs w/ 7% fills, grey grasses 12% — 560px tile

colorways.name: Periwinkle Vivid
colorways.motif: dense floret pattern: wavy 5-petal blooms, crossed 4-petal florets, clover trios, veined leaves — 280px tile, 13% stroke #3831c4

colorways.name: Emerald Bold
colorways.motif: dense leaf-vine tile: 8 winding stems, ~46 outline leaves — 300px tile, 16% stroke #1d8666

colorways.name: Orchid Bold
colorways.motif: delicate fine-line florals: 16-petal layered bloom, dandelion bursts, umbel sprays — 320px tile, 1.3px stroke 14% #ba3bba

themes.name: Carbon Day
grammar: steel-blue tints, motif-free by design (Focused discipline)
surfaces DEEPEN on carbon (like honey)
flat light grammar + dot-chips
white-lift chart wells (mono exception: deeper well)
mono = the no-color utility colorway: grey accent, only data is colored
reserve: Slate Bold (passed; its bar palette lives in Carbon Dimmed)
